d: An anthropomorphic lion with a voluminous, shaggy mane in shades of platinum white and ash grey, featuring a thick, swept-back texture. The eyes are a piercing, narrow gold with a focused expression, set into a mature, feline face. The build is tall and powerfully muscular, clothed in a red and orange ceremonial outfit consisting of a fitted bodice and a long, asymmetric draped skirt with gold geometric trim, paired with dark grey leggings. Signature details include gold ornate earrings, a gold collar, a large golden solar disk held aloft, and a long, tufted tail. BODY COLOR: Dark grey and white LEGS: Digitigrade with thick, dark grey paws.
